notes.title: Looking for native speakers
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
We're preparing the second part of the game and very soon we will need your help! 
We order a translation into different languages, but sometimes it is not entirely correct, because native speakers do not play our game but see only the text. Because of this, problems arise - the player misunderstands the meaning of some phrases. If you would like to help us with proofreading, please write us your language and your conditions on which you could help :)

Our e-mail: blazingplanetstudio@gmail.com

P.S. We would also like to find people who would be interested in helping to correct mistakes in the texts for the first part :)

notes.title: The Choice of Life: Middle Ages is a silly and short choice-based adventure
notes.notes:
An adventure that slightly reminds me of the Reigns series, The Choice of Life: Middle Ages has you pick from a couple cards to pick choices and go on your adventure.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/the-choice-of-life-middle-ages-is-a-silly-and-short-choice-based-adventur
